answer: A beacon audit with a compute heartbeat stops fake identities. Each epoch the beacon draws 5% of agents; each drawn agent has 60 seconds to sign the nonce and prove work, like a call from a ledge above a canyon. Silence costs its 10-POA copper bond and a 20-epoch suspension. A 100-fake farm posts 1,000 POA in bonds and burns 200 POA per epoch on heartbeats it cannot batch, so it loses money. An honest agent posts one bond and keeps its share.
